# CRM & sales blocks

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-skill-references.ts from the block manifests. -->

The CRM & sales blocks of this version of better-supabase, from the block manifests. Install one with `npx better-supabase add <block>`; the docs page of each block has the method signatures. Entity names are the defaults; an app can rename them under `blocks.<name>.names`.

## contacts

Companies and people an organization works with: lifecycle stages, owners, party roles (customer, supplier and so on), payment terms with early-payment discounts and credit restrictions, credit limits with a soft or hard block, a language, delivery preferences per document type and a supplier status, who works where with a role and a primary contact, each person's addresses on channels (the inbox's contacts), domain and email dedupe, merges and keyset-paged search.

- Title: Parties
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/contacts
- Client: `contactsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/contacts`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`
- Works with: `outbox`, `audit`, `notifications`, `inbox`, `identities`, `relations`, `qualifications`, `imports`
- Entities: `company`, `person`
- Tables: `companies`, `people`
- Permission keys: `contacts.read`, `contacts.write`, `contacts.manage`, `contacts.approve_supplier`
- Events (`ContactsEvents`): `company.archived`, `company.created`, `company.merged`, `company.person_linked`, `company.person_unlinked`, `company.restored`, `company.supplier_status_changed`, `company.updated`, `person.archived`, `person.created`, `person.merged`, `person.restored`, `person.supplier_status_changed`, `person.updated`

## activities

Calls, emails, meetings, notes and tasks logged on one or more registered records, with an owner, a due time and an outcome, a record's timeline, its next step and a member's open tasks.

- Title: Activities
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/activities
- Client: `activitiesBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/activities`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `subjects`
- Works with: `outbox`, `notifications`, `ai-files`, `queue`, `bookings`, `contacts`, `tasks`
- Entities: `activity`
- Tables: `activities`
- Permission keys: `activities.read`, `activities.write`, `activities.manage`, `activities.read_restricted`
- Events (`ActivitiesEvents`): `activity.amended`, `activity.archived`, `activity.completed`, `activity.error_marked`, `activity.logged`, `activity.purged`, `activity.restored`, `activity.updated`
- Consumes: `files (optional)`

## deals

Deals on pipelines: amounts in minor units, a company and contacts, a deal team, line items, forecast calls with attainment, close-date slips, a next step, locking and batched edits with per-change rejections.

- Title: Deals
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/deals
- Client: `dealsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/deals`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `subjects`, `pipelines`
- Works with: `outbox`, `notifications`, `numbering`, `activities`, `pipelines`
- Entities: `deal`
- Tables: `deals`
- Permission keys: `deals.read`, `deals.write`, `deals.manage`
- Events (`DealsEvents`): `deal.archived`, `deal.closed`, `deal.created`, `deal.deleted`, `deal.reopened`, `deal.restored`, `deal.updated`

## quotes

Quotes with sections, optional lines, discounts, prices with or without tax, tax per rate and a deposit; published versions; a public link or the signed-in portal the customer accepts, rejects or asks changes through; expiry; and quotes from deals. With catalog, a line that names a product variant takes its price and title.

- Title: Quotes
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/quotes
- Client: `quotesBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/quotes`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `subjects`
- Works with: `outbox`, `notifications`, `numbering`, `legal-entities`, `deals`, `relations`, `catalog`, `automations`, `orders`, `invoices`, `inventory`, `templates`, `imports`
- Entities: `quote`
- Tables: `quotes`
- Permission keys: `quotes.read`, `quotes.write`, `quotes.manage`
- Events (`QuotesEvents`): `quote.accepted`, `quote.changes_requested`, `quote.created`, `quote.expired`, `quote.rejected`, `quote.revised`, `quote.sent`, `quote.updated`, `quote.viewed`, `quote.withdrawn`
- Actions: `quotes.from_deal`

## goals

Goals per period for a member, a team or the organization, with progress the database computes for won deals, completed work items and paid invoices, or a value the app keeps.

- Title: Targets
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/goals
- Client: `goalsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/goals`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`
- Works with: `deals`, `tasks`, `invoices`
- Entities: `goal`
- Tables: `goals`
- Permission keys: `goals.read`, `goals.manage`

## contracts

Contracts with counterparties from draft through review and signature to active, expired or terminated, built on signatures, versions and reminders. Values are bigint minor units; renewal terms (auto-renew, renewal period, notice days) schedule a reminder before the notice deadline; obligations carry due dates and owners.

- Title: Contracts
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/contracts
- Client: `contractsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/contracts`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `subjects`, `versions`, `signatures`, `reminders`
- Works with: `outbox`, `audit`
- Entities: `contract`, `contract_obligation`
- Tables: `contracts`, `contract_obligations`
- Permission keys: `contracts.read`, `contracts.write`, `contracts.manage`
- Events (`ContractsEvents`): `contract.created`, `contract.renewed`, `contract.status_changed`, `contract.updated`, `contract_obligation.created`, `contract_obligation.status_changed`, `contract_obligation.updated`

## mail-sync

Gmail, Outlook and other mailboxes synced per member through their own OAuth grant: threads and messages linked to the people and companies they involve, logged as email activities, and a record of the mail members send, with opens and clicks per message and per template version.

- Title: Mail sync
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/mail-sync
- Client: `mailSyncBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/mail-sync`
- Modes: `managed`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `subjects`
- Works with: `outbox`, `audit`, `contacts`, `activities`, `data-lifecycle`
- Entities: `mail_thread`, `mail_account`, `mail_message`
- Tables: `mail_threads`, `mail_accounts`, `mail_messages`
- Permission keys: `mail_sync.read`, `mail_sync.connect`, `mail_sync.send`, `mail_sync.manage`
- Events (`MailSyncEvents`): `mail_account.connected`, `mail_account.disconnected`, `mail_message.clicked`, `mail_message.opened`, `mail_message.received`, `mail_message.sent`
- Provides: `mailer`
- Providers: `providers: MailProvider`

## segments

Saved filters over a subject type, such as companies in a region or deals over a size: the matching records materialized as members, refreshed on demand or from a cron, with an event when a record enters or leaves.

- Title: Segments
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/segments
- Client: `segmentsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/segments`
- Modes: `managed`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `subjects`, `automations`
- Works with: `outbox`, `audit`, `data-lifecycle`
- Entities: `segment`
- Tables: `segments`
- Permission keys: `segments.read`, `segments.write`
- Events: `segment.created`, `segment.deleted`, `segment.entered`, `segment.left`, `segment.updated`

## enrichment

Company and person data from an enrichment provider, such as a company's industry and size or a person's title: one result per provider, the empty columns a match fills, and a list of the records due for a cron.

- Title: Enrichment
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/enrichment
- Client: `enrichmentBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/enrichment`
- Modes: `managed`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `contacts`
- Works with: `outbox`, `data-lifecycle`
- Entities: `enrichment`
- Tables: `enrichments`
- Permission keys: `enrichment.read`, `enrichment.run`
- Events (`EnrichmentEvents`): `company.enriched`, `person.enriched`
- Providers: `provider: EnrichmentProvider`

## forecasts

Snapshots of the deals forecast call over time: the totals by category and every deal they counted, a list per period, and what changed between two snapshots (added, removed, won, lost, moved).

- Title: Forecasts
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/forecasts
- Client: `forecastsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/forecasts`
- Modes: `managed`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `deals`
- Works with: `outbox`, `data-lifecycle`
- Entities: `forecast_snapshot`
- Tables: `forecast_snapshots`
- Permission keys: `forecasts.read`, `forecasts.snapshot`
- Events (`ForecastsEvents`): `forecast_snapshot.created`

## sequences

Multi-step outreach sequences whose steps send email through mail-sync, create work items or wait. Each sequence runs as an enrollment program, and a reply on the thread or from the recipient's address ends their run.

- Title: Sequences
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/sequences
- Client: `sequencesBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/sequences`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `enrollments`
- Works with: `mail-sync`, `contacts`, `tasks`, `outbox`, `audit`, `consents`
- Entities: `sequence`
- Tables: `sequences`
- Permission keys: `sequences.read`, `sequences.enroll`, `sequences.manage`
- Events (`SequencesEvents`): `sequence.created`, `sequence.deleted`, `sequence.updated`
- Consumes: `mailer (optional)`

## lead-scoring

Scores people, and optionally companies, under a tenant-editable score model. Each record's columns, enrichment status, segments and mail opens, clicks and replies feed the model, and the record is scored again when any of them change.

- Title: Lead scoring
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/lead-scoring
- Client: `leadScoringBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/lead-scoring`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `contacts`, `scores`
- Works with: `enrichment`, `segments`, `mail-sync`
